title: Electronic failures near the Baltic Sea anomaly on a trip with Dennis Åsberg
place_text: Baltic Sea between Sweden and Finland

tellings.quote: I actually went with Dennis Åsberg who is um part of Ocean X. He's a treasure hunter. And the weirdest things happen when you're around this object.

plain: Electronics are said to fail near the Baltic Sea anomaly, an odd object on the seabed between Sweden and Finland. Michels says he saw this himself: he went out to the site with Dennis Åsberg, a treasure hunter with the diving team Ocean X, and says that "the weirdest things happen when you're around this object." If true, it would suggest the object does something to the equipment around it.
